one_line: Paid SEO data API provider covering SERP, keywords, on-page, backlinks, domain analytics, rank tracking and more.
auth_notes: Credentials are an API login + password (email) set in the dashboard; sent as HTTP Basic Authorization header on every request to api.dataforseo.com; REST with JSON/XML/HTML responses and per-endpoint rate limits.
self_serve_notes: Free unlimited trial (limited credits, no card) then pay-as-you-go; API login/password are generated instantly in the dashboard after signup, no approval needed.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Hundreds of endpoints across SERP (Google/Bing/etc. organic/maps/news), Keywords Data, On-page, Backlinks, Domain Analytics, Rank Tracking, Business Data, App Data, Merchant, Content Generation, Appendix; OpenAPI spec published
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks & callbacks supported for task completion notifications; standard (async) and live (sync) task methods

existing_mcp.note: No official DataForSEO MCP server; community MCP servers for DataForSEO exist on GitHub/MCP registries

evidence.note: Fetched text confirms REST technology, client libraries, JSON/XML/HTML responses, rate-limit headers, standard/live methods, webhooks & callbacks, sandbox and free trial

agent_notes: Auth is simple basic-auth login/password from the dashboard; free trial makes first call fast. Cost scales with usage but no approval gate.
